**Retrospective source inspection.** October 15, 2025 is a coverage label,
not a claim that this review or post occurred then. The source inspection
was completed on November 24, 2026 at 13:11:48 UTC-08:00. This draft is not
published; its publication date is unknown.

## What do the files map to?

The original project's [README at the inspected revision](https://github.com/dckodi-glitch/fantasy-changes/blob/8ca3bba8504b00649b8d3dcc6bfde30cdb7f17eb/README.md)
explains that input filenames use the week before the intended projection.
The [original notebook](https://github.com/dckodi-glitch/fantasy-changes/blob/8ca3bba8504b00649b8d3dcc6bfde30cdb7f17eb/Fantasy_Football_Project.ipynb)
and result files support the following mapping. A result file's `WK` field
is a recorded outcome-week label, not evidence that every receiver's outcome
is present.

| WR and defense inputs | Intended projection | Result file and recorded week | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| WR6, Defense6 | Week 7 | WR6Results: 7 | Source evidence only |
| WR7, Defense7 | Week 8 | WR7Results: 8 | **Exclude matchup analysis** |
| WR8, Defense8 | Week 9 | WR8Results: 9 | Source evidence only |
| WR9, Defense9 | Week 10 | WR9Results: 10 | Source evidence only |
| WR10, Defense10 | Week 11 | WR10Results: 11 | Source evidence only |
| WR12, Defense12 | Week 13 | No result file available | Outcome unavailable |

These filenames indicate intended projection weeks; they do **not** prove
the source data's season or publication time. The original project describes
the work as 2025, but snapshot availability dates and cutoff times are
unverified. Saved notebook outputs are historical evidence, not results
revalidated by this inspection.

## Why exclude the Week 8 matchup?

[Defense6.csv](https://github.com/dckodi-glitch/fantasy-changes/blob/8ca3bba8504b00649b8d3dcc6bfde30cdb7f17eb/Defense6.csv)
and [Defense7.csv](https://github.com/dckodi-glitch/fantasy-changes/blob/8ca3bba8504b00649b8d3dcc6bfde30cdb7f17eb/Defense7.csv)
are byte-for-byte identical, with SHA-256
`8cb321a4e7b58fb753b1a736fa535d90b5b585583b9a04777b4046bdeeec463b`.
The intended Week 8 defensive input is therefore unreliable. Both files and
the original notebook remain unchanged; unavailable slot/wide splits are not
reconstructed.

The notebook joins projection and outcome data by exact player name, so
spelling, punctuation or shared names can cause missed or incorrect matches.
Each available results export contains 100 rows except WR9Results, which
contains 99; they do not establish outcomes for all receivers. Repeated
`YDS` and `TD` column names also need positional care. Missing outcomes are
unknown, not zero. WR11/Defense11, WR12Results and other unprovided
historical snapshots are unavailable.
